setup.limitation: iRacing exposes no complete garage setup. Only the partial configuration below is measurable.

partial_configuration.limitation: Partial configuration only. Driver-adjustable control state, garage-set cold pressures and pending pit-service requests are distinct concepts and are not merged.

driver_adjustable_control.semantics: Driver-adjustable in-car settings. These change during a session, so the per-sample values in samples.csv are authoritative; this is the observed session entry state.

garage_cold_pressures_kpa.semantics: Garage-set COLD inflation pressure. This is setup state, not live running pressure; iRacing exposes no hot or running tire pressure variable at all.

pit_service_request.semantics: A PENDING REQUEST for the next pit stop. A requested pressure or compound is not the current tire state and must never be read as one.

current_tire_compound.semantics: Compound index in use at observation. Car- and content-dependent; no global scale.
